source_contract.query_rule: one exact query[term][artist_ids] request per frozen AIC agent ID, including preferred and non-preferred associated creators
source_contract.pagination_rule: page=1,limit=100; response limit/current_page/offset and zero-versus-one total_pages must be coherent, and total must equal returned rows
source_contract.terminal_condition: all four exact artist-ID responses pass delivery, pagination, identity, and schema validation
source_contract.canonicalization_rule: retain every returned row; globally sort by painter_id then numeric AIC artwork ID
source_contract.duplicate_rule: duplicate artwork IDs within or across painter responses are terminal
source_contract.rights_rule: record item is_public_domain and image_id without treating either as image-acquisition authorization
source_contract.raw_response_rule: stream decoded response bytes into a bounded buffer; store every complete accepted body once by SHA-256 in the census CAS, but for an oversize terminal response store and identify only the first maximum_response_bytes plus one evidence byte
source_contract.rate_limit_rule: wait at least minimum_interval_seconds between completed request access times; never send concurrent requests
source_contract.retry_rule: no within-census retry; any transport failure, non-200 status, redirect, final-URL drift, Retry-After, invalid Date/content type/schema/pagination/identity, response oversize, or CAS drift terminates the one-shot census and requires a new reviewed census ID
source_contract.failure_rule: preserve the lock, event ledger, and every received CAS body; publish neither candidate manifest nor receipt unless all four requests and all CAS objects verify

screening_contract.candidate_gate: target AIC agent ID and normalized name occur as a paired entry in artist_ids and artist_titles, plus painting classification, oil and canvas tokens, accession, public-domain flag, image ID, and reported short side at least 1024
screening_contract.authority_ceiling: AIC holding-record candidate only until role, attribution qualifier, physical-work identity, rights, and asset delivery are separately reconciled; thumbnail geometry is metadata only, provider-embedded LQIP stays solely in raw response CAS and is never decoded or published
screening_contract.malformed_field_rule: wrong JSON types in requested identity, authority, rights, classification, medium, accession, image, geometry, or list fields are terminal schema failures; null optional fields remain retained but fail their screen
